classification_rules: Official and reputable local reporting supports policy and timeline facts.
Vendor portal labels describe vendor semantics but not necessarily CPD's current native configuration.
Community observations are leads only until independently captured.
The eight Tennessee departments remain unnamed rather than guessed.

findings.finding: CPD's July 15 no-287(g) description was contradicted by four removals two days later.
The new public portal creates an observable representation, but its authority, schema, update cadence, and historical completeness remain unverified.
Dynamic partner eligibility requires continuous machine-assisted reconciliation, not point-in-time vetting.

data.method: Recursive lead expansion from the July 17 access correction through the July 27 public portal, with explicit fact/inference/unresolved separation.
data.research_question: Does Columbus have an authoritative, current, and auditable representation of every Flock data-sharing relationship?
